name: complete-heatmap-static-vanilla-js
description: Disaster Hazard Heatmap, Civic Incident & Safe Shelter Router in Static HTML + Vanilla JavaScript (Zero-Bundler ES Modules) using Google Maps Platform and deck.gl

scripts.build: node --check app.js && node --check server.mjs && node -e "import('fs').then(fs=>{const required=['index.html','app.js','styles.css','server.mjs','.env.example','.gitignore','README.md','AGENTS.md'];for(const f of required){if(!fs.existsSync(f))throw new Error('Missing required file: '+f);}console.log('Verified static assets and syntax checks passed.');})"
